fah-678.title: Hadouta Biscuits
fah-678.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-678.culturalNotes: Keeps a long time in a sealed metal tin. Serve with cheese or tea for a light breakfast.

instructions.1: Mix the oil and ghee in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the sugar, salt, baking powder and egg yolk and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the vinegar and keep stirring.
instructions.4: Add the flour gradually, stirring, until a dough forms.
instructions.5: Add the milk gradually until the dough is soft and easy to shape.
instructions.6: Cover and rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Roll out on a cornflour-dusted surface to about half a centimetre.
instructions.8: Cut into rectangles about 2 cm wide.
instructions.9: Dip the tops in egg white, then sprinkle sesame and nigella.
instructions.10: Set on an oiled tray.
instructions.11: Bake at 160°C for 15 minutes or until golden.
instructions.12: Cool before serving.

fah-679.title: Digestive Biscuits (No Eggs or Milk)
fah-679.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-679.culturalNotes: Serve with dips — hummus, areesh cheese, cherry tomatoes. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and butter and mix well.
instructions.3: Add water gradually until the dough is cohesive and easy to shape.
instructions.4: Cover the bowl with an oiled plastic sheet.
instructions.5: Roll a piece of dough between two plastic sheets to about half a centimetre.
instructions.6: Cut into equal circles.
instructions.7: Lay on an oiled tray and prick with a fork.
instructions.8: Bake at 170°C for 15 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Take out and cool.

fah-680.title: Savory Sesame & Nigella Biscuits
fah-680.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-680.culturalNotes: Have them with cheese or your favourite dip. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Heat the oven to 170°C.
instructions.2: Toast the sesame and nigella in a pan until fragrant.
instructions.3: Add half a cup of melted butter, half a cup of corn oil and half a cup of milk.
instructions.4: Add a teaspoon of salt, a tablespoon of sugar, a tablespoon of fine semolina and a teaspoon of baking powder.
instructions.5: Mix well.
instructions.6: Add the 2½ cups of sifted flour and stir until combined.
instructions.7: Roll on a plastic sheet to about half a centimetre.
instructions.8: Cut small shapes with a knife.
instructions.9: Arrange on an oiled tray.
instructions.10: Bake until golden top and bottom.
instructions.11: Take out and cool.
instructions.12: Serve with tea or coffee.

fah-681.title: Yogurt Date-Filled Biscuits
fah-681.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-681.culturalNotes: Serve with tea or any drink. A handy school snack too.

instructions.1: Mix the yogurt with the sugar until dissolved.
instructions.2: Add the ghee-oil mix and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the salt and vanilla and stir.
instructions.4: Add the flour and baking powder and mix by hand until a dough forms.
instructions.5: Press a thin layer into a plastic-lined rectangular tray.
instructions.6: Prepare the date paste with butter and extras to taste (sesame or cardamom).
instructions.7: Spread the date paste over the first dough layer.
instructions.8: Oil the tray, add half the remaining dough and spread it.
instructions.9: Add the date layer and cover with the rest of the dough.
instructions.10: Brush the top with milk, cream or ashta and sprinkle toasted sesame.
instructions.11: Cut into squares.
instructions.12: Bake at medium heat until browned.

fah-682.title: Eggless Biscuits with 3 Dips
fah-682.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-682.culturalNotes: Serve with the different dips for variety. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and butter and mix well.
instructions.3: Add water gradually until easy to shape.
instructions.4: Cover the bowl with an oiled plastic sheet.
instructions.5: Roll a piece between two plastic sheets to about half a centimetre.
instructions.6: Cut into equal circles.
instructions.7: Lay on an oiled tray.
instructions.8: Bake at 170°C for 15 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Prepare the dips:
instructions.10: Hummus dip: blend chickpeas, lemon juice, tahini, cumin, coriander, paprika, chopped tomato and cold water until smooth.
instructions.11: Yogurt dip: mix yogurt, areesh cheese, olive oil, salt and thyme.
instructions.12: Cheese dip: mix cubed cheese, chopped cherry tomatoes, chilli and olives.

fah-683.title: Chocolate Buns
fah-683.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-683.culturalNotes: The dough works sweet or savory. Dust with icing sugar for a prettier finish. The improver works in any dough for fluffiness and a sweet taste.

instructions.1: Mix the improver ingredients: yogurt, flour, baking powder and vinegar until foamy.
instructions.2: Separately, mix the flour, sugar, yeast and salt. Add the warm water and egg white and knead well.
instructions.3: Add the improver and knead for 10 minutes until stretchy and soft.
instructions.4: Oil the proving bowl, set the dough in, cover with plastic and a towel and prove until doubled.
instructions.5: Roll out, spread with soft butter, sugar and chocolate chips, then roll up and cut.
instructions.6: Brush the tops with yolk mixed with milk and vanilla. Add nuts to taste.
instructions.7: Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.

fah-684.title: Turkish Börek
fah-684.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-684.culturalNotes: Add other cheeses if you like. Freeze after cooking and reheat 30 seconds in the microwave. A snack or breakfast.

instructions.1: Mix the yogurt with butter until smooth and creamy.
instructions.2: Add 4–5 spoons of liquid butter and mix well.
instructions.3: Grease the tray with a butter-oil mix.
instructions.4: Brush a filo sheet with the yogurt-butter mix.
instructions.5: Spread cream cheese on it.
instructions.6: Add the cheese-and-basturma mix.
instructions.7: Roll the two sheets with the filling and lay on the tray.
instructions.8: Repeat until done.
instructions.9: Cut the börek into pieces.
instructions.10: Brush the tops with the butter-oil mix.
instructions.11: Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until golden.

fah-685.title: Turkish Börek with Mince
fah-685.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-685.culturalNotes: Keep the börek in the fridge up to 24 hours before baking. Serve with tomato sauce or red sauce.

instructions.1: Grate the raw potatoes.
instructions.2: Add the black pepper, paprika and salt to the grated potato and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the minced meat and mix until combined.
instructions.4: Take a filo sheet and brush with water then with ghee-oil.
instructions.5: Repeat with 3 sheets.
instructions.6: Lay the filling lengthwise on the last sheet and roll carefully.
instructions.7: Repeat for all sheets.
instructions.8: Set the börek on an oiled tray.
instructions.9: Brush the tops with yolk mixed with milk.
instructions.10: Sprinkle sesame and nigella.
instructions.11: Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Cool slightly before serving.

fah-686.title: Potato Pizza
fah-686.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-686.culturalNotes: Serve with a green salad or tomato sauce.

instructions.1: Heat a pan and add a tablespoon of butter.
instructions.2: Add the boiled mashed potato and stir well.
instructions.3: Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Spread in an oiled tray.
instructions.5: Top with the grated cheese.
instructions.6: Add the tomato, pepper and olive slices.
instructions.7: Bake on low for 15 minutes until the top is golden.
instructions.8: Serve hot.

fah-687.title: Mini Pizza Pies
fah-687.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-687.culturalNotes: Any cheese works. Keeps in the fridge for two days or freeze longer.

instructions.1: Mix the warm water with the sugar and yeast.
instructions.2: Leave 4 minutes to activate.
instructions.3: Add the flour, oil and salt and stir until a dough forms.
instructions.4: Rest for 10 minutes until doubled.
instructions.5: Cut into equal balls.
instructions.6: Oil a tray and press out the dough.
instructions.7: Add the cheese-and-pepper filling.
instructions.8: Bake in a very hot oven for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Serve hot.

fah-688.title: Tray Pizza with Cheese Sauce
fah-688.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-688.culturalNotes: Add any toppings you like. The dough keeps in the fridge up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, salt, baking powder and yeast in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add warm water gradually, kneading until a dough forms.
instructions.3: Add the oil and knead 3–4 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover and prove for 15 minutes.
instructions.5: Separately, melt the butter on low, add the flour and stir.
instructions.6: Add the milk gradually, stirring, until the sauce is smooth.
instructions.7: Add the mozzarella and stir until melted.
instructions.8: Take off and set aside.
instructions.9: Mix the tomato sauce, ketchup, onion powder, garlic powder and thyme.
instructions.10: Oil the oven tray and dust with semolina.
instructions.11: Spread the dough to shape.
instructions.12: Spread the pizza sauce evenly.
instructions.14: Add cheddar, mozzarella, salami, onion, green pepper, olives and chilli to taste.
instructions.15: Bake at 220°C for 15 minutes until golden.

fah-689.title: Soft Tasty Toast Bread
fah-689.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-689.culturalNotes: The dough should be smooth before proving. Milk powder in the flour improves the taste. A preheated oven gives better results.

fah-689-i11.name: Warm water to test the yeast

instructions.1: Mix the yeast and sugar in the quarter cup of warm water and leave 10 minutes to test it.
instructions.2: Mix the baking powder, improver and salt with the flour.
instructions.3: Add the yeast mix, warm milk, yogurt and oil and knead.
instructions.4: Add warm water gradually as needed until cohesive.
instructions.5: Knead for 10 minutes until smooth.
instructions.6: Cover and prove in a warm place for 30 minutes or until doubled.
instructions.7: Cut into small pieces and ball them.
instructions.8: Shape and set on an oiled tray.
instructions.9: Prove again 10–15 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush with a mix of milk powder, Nescafé, water and sugar.
instructions.11: Bake at 200°C for 20–30 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Cover with a towel out of the oven to soften for slicing.

fah-690.title: Filo Rolls with 4 Fillings
fah-690.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-690.culturalNotes: Filo keeps in the freezer for later. Serve hot or toast them.

instructions.1: Apple filling: cube the apples and cook with butter, cinnamon and sugar until the liquid dries off.
instructions.2: Fat mix: combine the yogurt, ghee and baking powder.
instructions.3: Potato filling: mash the boiled potatoes with cheese, parsley and cream cheese.
instructions.4: Cheese filling: mix mozzarella, pepper, Roumy and cream cheese.
instructions.5: Cheesecake filling: jam in one piping bag, cream cheese in another.
instructions.6: Lay a filo sheet, brush with the fat mix, fold in half and brush again. Put filling in the centre, fold the ends and roll.
instructions.7: Cook in a pan with a drop of ghee or oil, turning until golden all over.

fah-691.title: Danish
fah-691.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-691.culturalNotes: Sprinkle sesame on top for looks. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast with warm water and sugar and set aside to activate.
instructions.2: Separately, mix the flour, milk powder, baking powder and salt.
instructions.3: Add the yeast mix to the flour and knead well.
instructions.4: Add the oil gradually, kneading until soft and smooth.
instructions.5: Cover and prove for 30 minutes until doubled.
instructions.6: Cut into small pieces and ball them.
instructions.7: Roll each piece very thin.
instructions.8: Brush with butter and roll up.
instructions.9: Set on an oiled tray or baking paper.
instructions.10: Prove again 15 minutes.
instructions.11: Bake at 180°C for 15–20 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Brush with honey and jam and top with cherries.

fah-692.title: Baked Oil-Free Donuts
fah-692.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-692.culturalNotes: Grated dark chocolate in the sauce gives a stronger taste. Shape the donuts however you like.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg, vinegar and warm water gradually and knead for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the melted butter and knead 5 more minutes.
instructions.4: Cover and prove in a warm place for an hour until doubled.
instructions.5: Mix the milk, sugar, cornflour and cocoa and stir over the heat until thick.
instructions.6: Add the butter and stir until melted, then cool the sauce.
instructions.7: Cut the dough into equal pieces on an oiled tray.
instructions.8: Cover and prove again 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Heat the oven high for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush the donuts with yolk beaten with a spoon of milk.
instructions.11: Bake for 10–12 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Cool, then inject the chocolate sauce.

fah-693.title: Samosa Crisps
fah-693.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-693.culturalNotes: Change the filling as you like — vegetarian or cheese. Keeps in the freezer for up to a month.

instructions.1: Mix 3 cups of flour with a teaspoon of salt and 3 teaspoons of oil.
instructions.2: Add water gradually and knead to a medium dough.
instructions.3: Cover with plastic and rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.4: Cut into 14 small balls.
instructions.5: Flour the balls and roll thin.
instructions.6: Make the filling: brown the onion in ghee, add the spiced meat, spices and parsley and stir.
instructions.7: Put filling in the centre of each piece and seal well.
instructions.8: Cut the samosas to shape.
instructions.9: Fry in medium-hot oil until golden and crisp.

fah-694.title: Cheese Rolls
fah-694.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-694.culturalNotes: Freeze cooled rolls in sealed bags for later.

instructions.1: Mix the sugar and yeast in the warm water and leave 10 minutes to activate.
instructions.2: Add the sifted flour, baking powder and yogurt and mix well.
instructions.3: Knead for 5 minutes, add the oil and knead 5 more until smooth.
instructions.4: Cover and prove in a warm place for 30 minutes until doubled.
instructions.5: Dice the red and green pepper and mix with the baramily and cream cheese.
instructions.6: Flour the surface and roll the dough to half a centimetre.
instructions.7: Spread the filling and cut 2 cm slices.
instructions.8: Roll the slices and set on an oiled tray.
instructions.9: Prove again for 30 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle sesame and nigella.
instructions.11: Bake in a hot oven for 15 minutes until golden.

fah-695.title: Fluffy School Sandwiches
fah-695.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-695.culturalNotes: Freeze for later. Serve with a cup of tea.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, milk powder, salt, yeast, sugar and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt, oil and warm water gradually and mix well.
instructions.3: Knead for at least 10 minutes until cohesive and smooth.
instructions.4: Cover with plastic and a clean towel and prove for an hour.
instructions.5: Cut into equal parts and ball them.
instructions.6: Cover again and rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.7: Roll each ball into a thin rectangle.
instructions.8: Lay a sausage in the centre and roll up.
instructions.9: Halve the roll into mini sandwiches.
instructions.10: Arrange on an oiled tray and prove for 10 minutes.
instructions.11: Brush with egg and sprinkle sesame.
instructions.12: Bake in a hot oven for 15 minutes until golden.

fah-696.title: Cheese-Stuffed Sandwiches
fah-696.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-696.culturalNotes: Add any fillings you like. Keeps in the fridge two days or freeze longer. Serve hot or cold.

instructions.1: Mix the pastry flour, yeast, sugar and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg white, vinegar and warm water and knead for 10 minutes until soft and cohesive.
instructions.3: Cover and prove for half an hour in a warm place.
instructions.4: Cut into 8 equal pieces and ball them.
instructions.5: Roll each ball and stuff with your favourite filling (mixed cheese, olives, basturma, baramily, peppers, feta).
instructions.6: Seal well and shape into rolls.
instructions.7: Set in bread moulds.
instructions.8: Brush with yolk-milk mix and dust with rusks.
instructions.9: Brush with the butter-thyme-garlic-sesame mix.
instructions.10: Bake in a hot oven for 20 minutes until golden and crisp.

fah-697.title: Puff Samosas
fah-697.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-697.culturalNotes: Unfried samosas keep in the freezer for up to a month. Thaw slightly before frying.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, cornflour, baking powder, sugar, salt and milk powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the ghee or oil and mix until like sand grains.
instructions.3: Add warm water gradually and mix into a soft, non-sticky dough.
instructions.4: Cover and rest for 30 minutes to an hour.
instructions.5: Divide into 3 balls and cover.
instructions.6: Dust the surface with cornflour and roll to about half a centimetre.
instructions.7: Cut circles with a cutter.
instructions.8: Add your favourite filling and seal your way.
instructions.9: Set on an oiled or cornflour-dusted tray.
instructions.10: Deep-fry until golden on both sides.
instructions.11: Cook until golden and drain on a paper towel.

fah-698.title: Cinnabon Samosas
fah-698.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-698.culturalNotes: Serve with caramel or chocolate sauce. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the icing sugar with the cocoa and cinnamon in a bowl.
instructions.2: Fill the samosa strips with ashta or Kiri cheese.
instructions.3: Seal them into envelope shapes.
instructions.4: Heat oil in a pan, then lower the heat.
instructions.5: Fry until golden on both sides.
instructions.6: Drain on a paper towel.
instructions.7: Coat all over in the sugar-cocoa-cinnamon mix.
instructions.8: Serve hot with caramel or chocolate sauce.

fah-699.title: Multi-Filling Samosas (Meatless)
fah-699.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-699.culturalNotes: Freeze for later. Serve with red or white sauces.

instructions.1: Heat oil in a pan.
instructions.2: Add the garlic and fry until light yellow.
instructions.3: Add the boiled potatoes and mash well.
instructions.4: Add the cumin, coriander, black pepper, salt, spring onion, fresh coriander, red pepper, smoked paprika and potato spices and mix well.
instructions.5: Separately, heat oil and fry the chopped onion until soft.
instructions.6: Add the curry and black pepper and stir.
instructions.7: Add the boiled peas and carrots and the instant stock and stir.
instructions.8: Add salt and stir.
instructions.9: Cheese filling: mix areesh cheese with nigella, olive oil, ashta, parsley, pepper and black olives.
instructions.10: Second filling: mix cheddar, mozzarella, Roumy, cream cheese, red baladi pepper and coloured peppers.
instructions.11: Third filling: tomato, olives, basturma, the remaining cheese, ketchup and thyme.
instructions.12: Mix flour with water for the sealing paste.
instructions.13: Roll the dough and cut circles.
instructions.15: Brush the edges with the paste so they don't open while frying.
instructions.16: Fry in hot oil until golden.

fah-700.title: Crispy Anise Shaboura
fah-700.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-700.culturalNotes: Serve with a hot cup of tea. Nigella and anise are healthy ingredients.

instructions.1: Put the eggs in the blender.
instructions.2: Add the oil, sugar, vinegar, half a cup of milk, the vanilla and saffron.
instructions.3: Blend until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.4: Add the salt, nigella and baking powder and blend.
instructions.5: Add the flour gradually until a dough forms.
instructions.6: Grease a rectangular tin and spread the dough.
instructions.7: Sprinkle sesame and nigella on top.
instructions.8: Bake at 180°C.
instructions.9: Bake for 40–45 minutes until cooked.
instructions.10: Take out and cool slightly.
instructions.11: Slice and toast again at 140°C until crisp.

fah-701.title: Cream Filo Fingers
fah-701.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-701.culturalNotes: Serve hot or cold. Any nuts work. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Unroll the filo and cut into 10×10 cm squares.
instructions.2: Make the cream: a tin of ready ashta, or a cup of milk thickened with a spoon of cornflour on the heat.
instructions.3: Take two squares and lay cream along the diagonal, away from the edges.
instructions.4: Fold into fingers and set on a buttered tray.
instructions.5: A light drizzle of melted butter on each.
instructions.6: Bake at 200°C for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.7: Drizzle white honey over them straight out of the oven.

fah-702.title: Brioche Braids
fah-702.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-702.culturalNotes: Use good yeast and knead well for a fluffy result. Serve with coloured boiled eggs at Sham el-Nessim.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast and sugar in the warm milk.
instructions.2: Mix the salt into the flour.
instructions.3: Add the yeast-milk mix to the flour and knead well.
instructions.4: Add the butter and knead until smooth.
instructions.5: Cover and prove in a warm place for an hour.
instructions.6: Cut into small balls and roll each into a long strip.
instructions.7: Braid three strips and arrange on an oiled or lined tray.
instructions.8: Prove again for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: Brush with the yolk-milk-Nescafé mix.
instructions.10: Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.11: Serve hot with tea or coffee.

fah-703.title: Sandwich Dough (3 Fillings)
fah-703.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-703.culturalNotes: Use different fillings as you like. The dough keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Mix the sugar, yeast and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the milk powder, oil, 2 cups of warm water and the egg whites and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the sifted pastry flour, baking powder and vinegar. Knead for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Add the melted butter at the end and knead 2 more minutes.
instructions.5: Cover and prove for half an hour.
instructions.6: Dice the coloured peppers; slice the onion into wings.
instructions.7: Fry the sausages, peppers and onion, add the ketchup and hot sauce, stir and take off.
instructions.8: Dice coloured peppers; mince the red onion finely.
instructions.9: Add the drained tuna, corn, mayonnaise, hot sauce, mustard, salt and vinegar and mix.
instructions.10: Dice the peppers, pickles and cold cuts or roast beef.
instructions.11: Add mayonnaise, ketchup, a pinch of paprika, chilli, onion powder and garlic powder and mix.
instructions.12: Cut the dough small and weigh each piece at 25–30 g.
instructions.13: Fill each piece, seal and set on an oiled tray.
instructions.14: Cover with plastic and prove for half an hour.
instructions.15: Mix the egg wash from the yolks, milk and vanilla and brush the buns.
instructions.16: Bake at the highest heat until golden.
instructions.17: Stuff with the fillings. Serve hot.

fah-704.title: Tortilla Bread
fah-704.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-704.culturalNotes: Freeze them in bags. Use them for all kinds of sandwiches.

instructions.1: Mix the flour and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the hot water gradually until the dough gathers.
instructions.4: Knead a minute or two until cohesive.
instructions.5: Cut into 15 small pieces and ball them.
instructions.6: Flour the balls and cover with plastic.
instructions.7: Roll each into a thin flatbread with flour.
instructions.8: Trim the edges with a knife.
instructions.9: Heat a pan over medium and lay in a bread.
instructions.10: Flip when the colour changes.
instructions.11: Take off and cover.
instructions.12: Repeat for all the breads.

fah-705.title: No-Knead Fasting Bread
fah-705.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-705.culturalNotes: Works sweet or savory. Keeps in an airtight container for two days.

instructions.1: Blend the warm water with the salt, yeast, sugar and baking powder.
instructions.2: Add the semolina and blend for 5 minutes until smooth.
instructions.3: Cover and prove in a warm place for 15 minutes.
instructions.4: Heat a pan over medium and oil it.
instructions.5: Pour in the batter and cover until the top sets.
instructions.6: Flip until golden on the other side.
instructions.7: Brush with butter while hot if you like.

fah-706.title: No-Oven Potato Pies
fah-706.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-706.culturalNotes: Add cooked chicken cubes, basturma or anything else. Serve hot or cold.

instructions.1: Mix the warm water, yeast, flour, sugar and oil in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Knead until like damp sand.
instructions.3: Add warm water gradually until a soft dough forms.
instructions.4: Knead for at least 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Cover with film and a clean towel and prove for an hour in a warm place.
instructions.6: Separately, fry the chopped onion in 2 spoons of oil until golden.
instructions.7: Add the paprika, black pepper and salt and mix well.
instructions.8: Add the mashed potatoes and mixed cheese and combine.
instructions.9: Cut the dough into small balls and roll each with a fork.
instructions.10: Put filling in the centre of each pie and seal well.
instructions.11: Shape as you like (half-moon or round).
instructions.12: Heat oil in a pan over medium and fry the pies.
instructions.13: Turn until golden on both sides.

fah-707.title: Pizza Pies
fah-707.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-707.culturalNotes: Freeze in plastic bags. Reheat 5–7 minutes in the oven.

instructions.1: Dissolve the yeast and sugar in a cup of warm milk for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Mix the sifted flour and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.3: Add the yeast-milk mix and knead well.
instructions.4: Add the egg white, the quarter cup of oil and the vinegar and mix.
instructions.5: Add warm water gradually for a soft, elastic dough.
instructions.6: Rest in a warm place until doubled.
instructions.7: Cut into small balls; oil a cup.
instructions.8: Press each ball into the cup to form a dish.
instructions.9: Add your favourite filling (peppers, tomato, olives, cheese) in the centre.
instructions.10: Make the wash from the yolk, 2 spoons of milk, a pinch of instant coffee and a teaspoon of sugar.
instructions.11: Brush the tops and sprinkle sesame to taste.
instructions.12: Bake at 180°C for 10–15 minutes until golden.

fah-708.title: Fried Cheese Pies
fah-708.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-708.culturalNotes: Change the filling — cheddar, Roumy or spiced meat. The pies don't soak up much oil if fried right.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar and salt in a deep bowl.
instructions.2: Add the vinegar and yogurt, then water gradually until soft and non-sticky.
instructions.3: Knead well for 5 minutes, cover and rest 10.
instructions.4: Divide into equal small balls.
instructions.5: Cover with a clean towel and rest 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Roll each ball on a floured board.
instructions.7: Put the baramily-and-cream-cheese filling in the centre and seal the edges.
instructions.8: Cut with a pizza cutter or crimper.
instructions.9: Fry in medium-hot oil until golden on both sides.
instructions.10: Drain on paper.

fah-709.title: Halloumi Pies
fah-709.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-709.culturalNotes: Any cheese works. Serve with tea or coffee as a snack.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt, vinegar and oil and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the warm milk gradually and knead until soft and non-sticky.
instructions.4: Rest in a warm place for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Cut into small balls and rest again.
instructions.6: Cube the halloumi.
instructions.7: Shape each ball into a disc with a cheese cube in the centre.
instructions.8: Seal well and arrange on an oiled tray.
instructions.9: Brush with the egg-milk-coffee-sugar wash.
instructions.10: Bake at 220°C.
instructions.11: Bake for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Flip for 5 more minutes to brown the other side.

fah-710.title: Tea Pies with Baramily Cheese
fah-710.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-710.culturalNotes: Freeze in plastic bags; reheat in the microwave or oven.

instructions.1: Mix the milk, oil, water, sugar, yeast and vinegar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Rest for 15 minutes to activate the yeast.
instructions.3: Add the flour, salt and vinegar and mix into a soft smooth dough.
instructions.4: Knead for at least 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Cover with plastic and a clean towel and prove for an hour.
instructions.6: Cut into lemon-sized balls.
instructions.7: Roll each thin and put the baramily filling in the centre.
instructions.8: Cut strips and wrap them around.
instructions.9: Arrange on an oiled or lined tray.
instructions.10: Mix the glaze from the coffee, milk powder, sugar and water.
instructions.11: Brush the tops with the glaze.
instructions.12: Bake in a very hot oven for 20 minutes until golden.

fah-711.title: Rose Pies
fah-711.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-711.culturalNotes: Freeze once cooled. Serve with tea at breakfast or in kids' lunchboxes.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, milk powder, sugar, yeast and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add warm water gradually, kneading until soft and non-sticky.
instructions.3: Add the oil and knead at least 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Oil a bowl, set the dough in, cover with plastic and a towel and prove until doubled.
instructions.5: Cut into equal balls (large-lemon size).
instructions.6: Roll each and cut into 4 parts, keeping the middle intact.
instructions.7: Put the cheddar-and-half-olive filling in the centre and close as shown.
instructions.8: Arrange on an oiled tray, cover and prove again.
instructions.9: Brush with the egg-vinegar mix.
instructions.10: Bake in a hot oven until cooked.
instructions.11: Cover straight out of the oven to keep them soft.

fah-712.title: Flaky Pâté & Croissants
fah-712.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-712.culturalNotes: The same dough makes cinnamon rolls and donuts. Keeps in the fridge up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Make the improver: mix half a cup of flour, a tablespoon of baking powder, a cup of yogurt, a tablespoon of honey and a quarter cup of vinegar until it rises.
instructions.2: Make the dough: mix a kilo of flour, the yeast, milk powder and salt. Add the improver and knead, adding water gradually until it comes together.
instructions.3: Add the 2 eggs and knead at least 10 minutes until elastic.
instructions.4: Add a quarter cup each of butter and oil and knead 10 more minutes.
instructions.5: Cover and prove for two hours in a warm place.
instructions.6: Cut into balls of about 100 g.
instructions.7: Roll each, dot with a teaspoon of butter, dust with flour and roll up.
instructions.8: Repeat for all balls.
instructions.9: Cover and rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: For pâté: roll out, add baramily and roll up.
instructions.11: Set on an oiled tray.
instructions.12: For croissants: roll out, roll one side over and roll up.
instructions.16: Make the wash: egg whites, 2 spoons of milk and a pinch of instant coffee.
instructions.17: Brush the pastries and add nigella or sesame to taste.
instructions.18: Bake at 180°C for 20–25 minutes until golden.
instructions.19: Brush the danish with apricot jam.

fah-713.title: Potato & Egg Pies
fah-713.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-713.culturalNotes: A date filling — black dates, toasted sesame and butter — works too. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and water and knead until cohesive.
instructions.3: Cover and rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.4: Cut into an even number of small balls.
instructions.5: Roll pairs of balls, put the filling in the centre and seal.
instructions.6: Make the filling: mash the boiled potatoes with the chopped boiled egg, parsley, salt, pepper and spices.
instructions.7: Fry in a little oil until golden on both sides.
instructions.8: Serve hot.

fah-714.title: Turkish Pies with Cheese Soak
fah-714.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-714.culturalNotes: Use good active yeast. Fill with mashed potato or parsley instead. Keeps in the fridge two days or freeze longer.

instructions.1: Mix the flour and baking powder in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Separately, mix the warm water, warm milk, oil, yeast, sugar and salt.
instructions.3: Add the liquids to the flour and mix well.
instructions.4: Knead at least 10 minutes until smooth, soft and non-sticky.
instructions.5: Cover with plastic and prove for an hour until doubled.
instructions.6: Cut into balls a bit larger than a lemon.
instructions.7: Stuff each with cream cheese and seal.
instructions.8: Dust a tray with flour and space the pies on it.
instructions.9: Prove again for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Make the soak from milk and cream cheese, mixed well.
instructions.11: Soak the pies with it.
instructions.12: Brush with the egg-Nescafé-vinegar mix.
instructions.15: Cover with a warm towel for 5 minutes out of the oven.

fah-715.title: Flaky Turkish Pies
fah-715.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-715.culturalNotes: Keeps a long time in the freezer. Reheat a minute in the microwave or oven.

instructions.1: Mix the warm water and milk with the sugar and yeast.
instructions.2: Leave 10–15 minutes for the yeast to foam.
instructions.3: Add the flour, oil and salt and knead at least 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover and prove in a warm place until doubled.
instructions.5: Cut into 14 equal balls and cover.
instructions.6: Roll each very thin with flour.
instructions.7: Brush with butter, add the cheese-and-olive filling and roll up.
instructions.8: Roll the log thinner and coil it, sealing the end.
instructions.9: Arrange on an oiled tray and prove again.
instructions.10: Brush with the yolk-vinegar mix.
instructions.11: Bake at 220°C for 15 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Cover with a clean towel to keep them moist.
instructions.13: Once cold, freeze in plastic bags.

fah-716.title: Russian Meat Pies
fah-716.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-716.culturalNotes: The dough should be flaky and soft when rolled. Change the filling as you like.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add water gradually and knead 10 minutes until soft and non-sticky.
instructions.3: Set in an oiled bowl, cover and prove in a warm place for 30 minutes.
instructions.4: Separately, mix the mince with the onion, tomato, chilli, bell pepper and spices.
instructions.5: Cut the dough into 12 equal balls.
instructions.6: Roll each on a butter-oiled surface and put the meat filling in the centre.
instructions.7: Roll the dough around the filling in a spiral, tucking the end under.
instructions.8: Arrange on an oiled tray and rest 30 minutes.
instructions.9: Bake at 200°C for 20–25 minutes until golden.

fah-717.title: Quick Cheese Pies
fah-717.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-717.culturalNotes: Freeze once completely cooled. Thaw a little and rebake when needed.

instructions.1: Mix a cup of flour with the yeast and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the warm water and mix until combined.
instructions.3: Cover and rest in a warm place 15 minutes until doubled.
instructions.4: Add a cup and a half of flour and the salt and mix into a smooth dough.
instructions.5: Knead at least 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Cover and prove for 15 minutes.
instructions.7: Cut into 8 equal balls.
instructions.8: Stuff with the mixed cheese and seal the edges well.
instructions.9: Brush with the thyme-garlic butter.
instructions.10: Arrange on an oiled tray and bake on high until golden.
instructions.11: Brush with hot butter out of the oven.
instructions.12: Serve hot with tea or mint.
